per_query.query: How many days do I have to request a 0% intro balance transfer on Apex Platinum?
per_query.gold_response: Apex Platinum cardholders have 60 days from account opening to request a 0% intro balance transfer. The intro rate lasts for 15 billing cycles, and a fee of 3% or $10 applies.
per_query.answer: For the Apex Platinum card, the 2024 policy states that the promotional 0% intro APR applies to balance transfers requested within 60 days of account creation.

citations.title: Apex Platinum - 0% Intro APR Balance Transfer Rules (2024)

[E1] chunk_id=DOC-0001 | doc_id=DOC-0001 | title=Apex Platinum - 0% Intro APR Balance Transfer Rules (2024) | category=Balance Transfers | card_tier=Apex Platinum | effective_year=2024 | policy_code=BT-001
Policy Code: BT-001-APEX-2024. Applicable Product: Apex Platinum. Policy Effective Year: 2024. Category: Balance Transfers. Details: Promotional 0% intro APR applies for 15 billing cycles from account opening on balance transfers requested within 60 days of account creation. A balance transfer fee of 3% or $10 (whichever is greater) applies to each transfer. Standard balance transfer APR ranges from 18.24% to 28.24% variable based on creditworthiness after the intro period ends. Transfers cannot be made between existing Apex accounts.

Policy Code: BT-001-APEX-2024. Applicable Product: Apex Everyday Freedom. Policy Effective Year: 2024. Category: Balance Transfers. Policy Code: BT-001-APEX-2024. Applicable Product: Apex Business Select. Policy Effective Year: 2024. Category: Balance Transfers. Policy Code: BT-002-APEX-2025. Applicable Product: Apex Platinum. Policy Effective Year: 2025. Category: Balance Transfers. Policy Code: BT-002-APEX-2025. Applicable Product: Apex Everyday Freedom. Policy Effective Year: 2025. Category: Balance Transfers.
